why: Leo 2026-11-07: opt-in usage recording. The logic lives outside the App (UsageRecorder, UsageEventQueue and UsageEvent in CmuxNextControl, the recorder and report in Rust cmux-usage); the App part is glue over App-only types: the one-line AppServices+UsageRecordingHost forwards, holding the recorder in AppProcessRoot and wiring it in AppDelegate, the focus-settle call in InputVerificationService, and the CLI confirmation sheet's privacy summary in UserOnlySettingConfirmation.
